# uzc_egress_firewall_rule (Resource)

Manages an egress firewall rule on a UzCloud isolated network. There is no update endpoint, so changing any attribute recreates the rule. The resource ID is "{network}/{rule_id}".

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_egress_firewall_rule" "example" {
  network    = uzc_network.example.slug
  protocol   = "tcp"
  cidr_list  = "0.0.0.0/0"
  start_port = "80"
  end_port   = "80"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr_list` (String) Source CIDR block (e.g. "0.0.0.0/0").
- `network` (String) Slug of the uzc_network to attach the rule to.
- `protocol` (String) One of "tcp", "udp", "icmp", or "all".

### Optional

- `destination_cidr_list` (String) Destination CIDR block.
- `end_port` (String) Leave unset for protocols that don't use ports.
- `icmp_code` (String) Used only when protocol is "icmp".
- `icmp_type` (String) Used only when protocol is "icmp".
- `start_port` (String) Leave unset for protocols that don't use ports.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) "{network}/{rule_id}". Used for import.
- `rule_id` (String) Server-assigned rule id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_egress_firewall_rule.example <network-slug>/<rule-id>
```
